g.data-tip: t3 (cooperative): k_sem_take(o1). Step 1 of the TLC trace (state 1 -> 2). k_sem_take(o1, K_FOREVER) (sem.c:127): k_spin_lock(&sem_lock) (sem.c:134). k_spin_lock() raises BASEPRI (spinlock.h:204, asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57). The count is 0: z_pend_curr() (sem.c:153). The model object o1 stands for each object: each wait of an object calls z_pend_curr().
g.title: t3 (cooperative): k_sem_take(o1). Step 1 of the TLC trace (state 1 -> 2). k_sem_take(o1, K_FOREVER) (sem.c:127): k_spin_lock(&sem_lock) (sem.c:134). k_spin_lock() raises BASEPRI (spinlock.h:204, asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57). The count is 0: z_pend_curr() (sem.c:153). The model object o1 stands for each object: each wait of an object calls z_pend_curr().

g.data-tip: t3 (cooperative): z_pend_curr(). z_pend_curr() (sched.c:531) -> pend_locked() (sched.c:559) -> add_to_waitq_locked() (sched.c:429) -> unready_thread() (sched.c:434): t3 leaves the run queue and waits on o1. unready_thread() calls update_cache(thread == _current) = update_cache(1) (sched.c:247). update_cache(1) (sched.c:161): preempt_ok = 1, so should_preempt() returns true at once (kthread.h:248-249). cache = next_up() = head of the run queue = t2 (sched.c:173).
g.title: t3 (cooperative): z_pend_curr(). z_pend_curr() (sched.c:531) -> pend_locked() (sched.c:559) -> add_to_waitq_locked() (sched.c:429) -> unready_thread() (sched.c:434): t3 leaves the run queue and waits on o1. unready_thread() calls update_cache(thread == _current) = update_cache(1) (sched.c:247). update_cache(1) (sched.c:161): preempt_ok = 1, so should_preempt() returns true at once (kthread.h:248-249). cache = next_up() = head of the run queue = t2 (sched.c:173).

g.data-tip: t3 (cooperative): z_swap(): switch. z_swap_locked() (sched.c:561, kswap.h:234) -> do_swap() (kswap.h:183, kswap.h:79): new thread = _kernel.ready_q.cache = t2 (kswap.h:112), arch_switch() (kswap.h:162) = arm_m_switch() (arm-m-switch.h:220). The new thread sets BASEPRI 0 after the stack switch (arm-m-switch.h:307).
g.title: t3 (cooperative): z_swap(): switch. z_swap_locked() (sched.c:561, kswap.h:234) -> do_swap() (kswap.h:183, kswap.h:79): new thread = _kernel.ready_q.cache = t2 (kswap.h:112), arch_switch() (kswap.h:162) = arm_m_switch() (arm-m-switch.h:220). The new thread sets BASEPRI 0 after the stack switch (arm-m-switch.h:307).

g.data-tip: Device ISR: entry. Step 2 of the TLC trace (state 2 -> 3). Exception entry: the device interrupt of the ISR i1 of the model. An ISR that calls the kernel runs only while BASEPRI is 0. The entry does not change BASEPRI. The trace does not name one action: the same states also come from t2: k_sem_give(o1) or ISR: k_event_post(o1) or t2: k_event_post(o1) or ISR: wake with object code(o1) or t2: wake with object code(o1).
g.title: Device ISR: entry. Step 2 of the TLC trace (state 2 -> 3). Exception entry: the device interrupt of the ISR i1 of the model. An ISR that calls the kernel runs only while BASEPRI is 0. The entry does not change BASEPRI. The trace does not name one action: the same states also come from t2: k_sem_give(o1) or ISR: k_event_post(o1) or t2: k_event_post(o1) or ISR: wake with object code(o1) or t2: wake with object code(o1).

g.data-tip: Device ISR: k_sem_give(o1). k_sem_give(o1) (sem.c:95): k_spin_lock(&sem_lock) (sem.c:97). k_spin_lock() raises BASEPRI (spinlock.h:204, asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57). z_sched_wake(0) (sem.c:102, ksched.h:295): the best waiter leaves the wait queue (ksched.h:301), its timeout is cancelled (ksched.h:262), it gets the return value 0 and is made ready (ksched.h:306). Woken: t3. Each woken thread: ready_thread() (sched.c:212): queue_thread() (sched.c:224), update_cache(0) (sched.c:225). On one CPU z_sched_wake() takes no second lock (kspinlock.h:23-25). update_cache(0) (sched.c:161): _current t2 is ready and cooperative, so should_preempt() is false (kthread.h:276). cache = _current = t2 (sched.c:175).
g.title: Device ISR: k_sem_give(o1). k_sem_give(o1) (sem.c:95): k_spin_lock(&sem_lock) (sem.c:97). k_spin_lock() raises BASEPRI (spinlock.h:204, asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57). z_sched_wake(0) (sem.c:102, ksched.h:295): the best waiter leaves the wait queue (ksched.h:301), its timeout is cancelled (ksched.h:262), it gets the return value 0 and is made ready (ksched.h:306). Woken: t3. Each woken thread: ready_thread() (sched.c:212): queue_thread() (sched.c:224), update_cache(0) (sched.c:225). On one CPU z_sched_wake() takes no second lock (kspinlock.h:23-25). update_cache(0) (sched.c:161): _current t2 is ready and cooperative, so should_preempt() is false (kthread.h:276). cache = _current = t2 (sched.c:175).

g.data-tip: Device ISR: z_reschedule(). z_reschedule() (sem.c:110, sched.c:652): resched() is false in an ISR (sched.c:374), so k_spin_unlock() (sched.c:401) writes the key back to BASEPRI (spinlock.h:346, asm_inline_gcc.h:89). The exit of the ISR is the reschedule point.
g.title: Device ISR: z_reschedule(). z_reschedule() (sem.c:110, sched.c:652): resched() is false in an ISR (sched.c:374), so k_spin_unlock() (sched.c:401) writes the key back to BASEPRI (spinlock.h:346, asm_inline_gcc.h:89). The exit of the ISR is the reschedule point.

g.data-tip: Device ISR: exit. z_arm_int_exit() = arm_m_exc_tail() (irq.h:128) -> arm_m_exc_exit() -> arm_m_must_switch() (arm-m-switch.c:510): BASEPRI raised (arm-m-switch.c:518), cache t2 = _current (ksched.h:83): no switch. BASEPRI 0 at the return (arm-m-switch.c:638-639).
g.title: Device ISR: exit. z_arm_int_exit() = arm_m_exc_tail() (irq.h:128) -> arm_m_exc_exit() -> arm_m_must_switch() (arm-m-switch.c:510): BASEPRI raised (arm-m-switch.c:518), cache t2 = _current (ksched.h:83): no switch. BASEPRI 0 at the return (arm-m-switch.c:638-639).

g.data-tip: t2 (cooperative): t2 runs. t2 runs its own code in thread mode.
g.title: t2 (cooperative): t2 runs. t2 runs its own code in thread mode.

g.data-tip: t2 (cooperative): requeue t1 (same prio). Step 3 of the TLC trace (state 3 -> 4). z_impl_k_thread_priority_set(t1, 0) (thread.c:1629) -> z_thread_prio_set() (thread.c:1637, sched.c:596): Z_SCHED_SPINLOCK (kspinlock.h:34) is a k_spin_lock(): BASEPRI is raised (spinlock.h:204, asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57) (sched.c:601). t1 is ready: dequeue_thread(), prio = 0, queue_thread() (sched.c:606-608): t1 goes behind each ready thread of the same priority, also when the priority does not change. On one CPU this is also true for _current. The trace does not name one action: the same states also come from ISR: k_thread_priority_set(t1, 0).
g.title: t2 (cooperative): requeue t1 (same prio). Step 3 of the TLC trace (state 3 -> 4). z_impl_k_thread_priority_set(t1, 0) (thread.c:1629) -> z_thread_prio_set() (thread.c:1637, sched.c:596): Z_SCHED_SPINLOCK (kspinlock.h:34) is a k_spin_lock(): BASEPRI is raised (spinlock.h:204, asm_inline_gcc.h:56-57) (sched.c:601). t1 is ready: dequeue_thread(), prio = 0, queue_thread() (sched.c:606-608): t1 goes behind each ready thread of the same priority, also when the priority does not change. On one CPU this is also true for _current. The trace does not name one action: the same states also come from ISR: k_thread_priority_set(t1, 0).

g.data-tip: t2 (cooperative): update_cache(1). sched.c:631. update_cache(1) (sched.c:161): preempt_ok = 1, so should_preempt() returns true at once (kthread.h:248-249). cache = next_up() = head of the run queue = t3 (sched.c:173). The cooperative test (kthread.h:262-263) does not run.
g.title: t2 (cooperative): update_cache(1). sched.c:631. update_cache(1) (sched.c:161): preempt_ok = 1, so should_preempt() returns true at once (kthread.h:248-249). cache = next_up() = head of the run queue = t3 (sched.c:173). The cooperative test (kthread.h:262-263) does not run.

g.data-tip: t2 (cooperative): unlock. The end of Z_SCHED_SPINLOCK in z_thread_prio_set(): k_spin_unlock() writes the key back to BASEPRI (spinlock.h:346, asm_inline_gcc.h:89). An interrupt can come here: its exit switches to the cache (t3) if it differs from _current.
g.title: t2 (cooperative): unlock. The end of Z_SCHED_SPINLOCK in z_thread_prio_set(): k_spin_unlock() writes the key back to BASEPRI (spinlock.h:346, asm_inline_gcc.h:89). An interrupt can come here: its exit switches to the cache (t3) if it differs from _current.

g.data-tip: t2 (cooperative): z_reschedule_unlocked(). thread.c:1641 -> z_reschedule_irqlock(arch_irq_lock()) (ksched.h:157): resched() is true (sched.c:374), need_swap(): cache t3 != _current t2 (sched.c:390-391): z_swap_irqlock() (sched.c:658-659) -> do_swap() (kswap.h:176, kswap.h:79): new thread = _kernel.ready_q.cache = t3 (kswap.h:112), arch_switch() (kswap.h:162) = arm_m_switch() (arm-m-switch.h:220). The new thread sets BASEPRI 0 after the stack switch (arm-m-switch.h:307).
g.title: t2 (cooperative): z_reschedule_unlocked(). thread.c:1641 -> z_reschedule_irqlock(arch_irq_lock()) (ksched.h:157): resched() is true (sched.c:374), need_swap(): cache t3 != _current t2 (sched.c:390-391): z_swap_irqlock() (sched.c:658-659) -> do_swap() (kswap.h:176, kswap.h:79): new thread = _kernel.ready_q.cache = t3 (kswap.h:112), arch_switch() (kswap.h:162) = arm_m_switch() (arm-m-switch.h:220). The new thread sets BASEPRI 0 after the stack switch (arm-m-switch.h:307).
